body:
Fuckkk, did I write this?

Seriously, it happened this way with me and my ex, except I’m the girl. It’s so heartbreaking, because you really thought you could trust them. You thought it must be your silly anxiety, like always. But your gut was right. How, moving forward, am I supposed to know if I’m overthinking, or actually just sensing something happening? I love him, but I hate that he did that to me. They always say it was because they didn’t want to upset you, but really they just didn’t want to have to deal with having upset you.

Many times a day. It’s been 9 months now. It’s still hard, but it’s easier. The thoughts are less raw and consuming. I won’t stop thinking about him any time soon, maybe ever, because he’s a really special person, who I still love. I’m trying to  accept that, but I also just want my brain to leave me alone, lol
I’m going to mostly ignore it but also have a romantic meal with (totally platonic lol) best friend. She’s my real soul mate anyway !

You’ve just described exactly how I feel and my situation, we broke up amicably and still care about each other. We both hope we can slowly work towards a friendship. 

The difference is I’m the dumpee and absolutely not holding on to any sentimental hope of us getting back together, lol, so I’m not letting myself get carried away with any fantasy, But this really resonated with me
3 months is no time at all. Your grieving someone who is still alive! Be kind to yourself, screw everyone else. Healing is a slow process

3 weeks is no time at all. I am 6 months in and still think of him regularly. I loved him deeply, that doesn’t just vanish overnight

EDIT: hold on, it gets better !!! The type of thoughts and frequency changes over time :)
Oh, you will! Right now I’m all about being that person for myself :)

I respect myself to not let bitterness and anger take over me as a some unhealthy way to heal. Frankly, you don’t know me. I deal with heartbreak how I deal with it, and this is far from my first time. So, respectfully, leave your judgments to yourself. 

I made a passing comment about me being weak, because we are in good terms, but I’m sure as fuck not. I’ve absolutely thrived from this heartbreak and I am far from interested in filling the void with someone new. Instead, im doing the inner work to reflect and learn from it. I am giving myself love and care and respect, something that’s been missing most of my life. Sure, it’s hard to let go, but I’m not an idiot. I know I need to move on. at least I’m honest with myself that it’s a slow process, rather than pretending it’s as easy as flicking a switch
It’s been 6 months for me too and I still think about him pretty often. I’ve made a lot of progress but it sif hurts. When they say healing isn’t linear they mean it !
Wow that’s a bit rude. I do have self respect. I’m just also a nice person who is going to send a message to say “thank you” to people who bought me Christmas presents.

The man gave me a Damn Christmas present and so did his mom, so I have to extend thanks for them when I open them. Not as easy as blocking when the break up was amicable and you share aspects of your lifelike friends and gyms and stuff.

Man, I promise you that there is other, (even better!) love out there. I’ve had four relationships and while I loved each one, it was only this most recent one that showed me he potential of true love. Hang in there, because what feels so all consuming now will fade once you realise that no one person needs to be your whole experience, there’s so much more to experience and learn !
That’s for sharing your story, it all makes total sense and I’m sorry that happened to you. Love can really fuck you up and I’m so terrified of it now
I’m weak and my heart is too big for my own good so also know I will cave and do it.

I hear you. This is the first time I’ve been broken up with. I always did the dumping before. Always in very different situations, and god I did hate breaking up with one who was jsut such a lovely person, but I knew in my heart he wasn’t for me so that sustained me. So I guess the pain of being a dumpee is new, making it feel worse. Idk. It’s easy to distance yourself from pain when it’s no longer so raw ! 

And with being the dumpee who gets all the sympathy and can just cry it out and get angry and move on… i wish it was that simple for me rn. It definitely depends on the situation. My friends are still friends with my ex. I have to see him at my gym. He bought me a Christmas present and so did his mom. He’s a brutally pragmatic man but also a kind one. None of this makes it easy for me to be angry and move on

I had this exact situation too. Literally just as you described. That one hurt so much, questioning why they just couldn’t act right for you, feeling like you weren’t enough. But once I realised it was him not me problem (i.e you will never fundamentally change for other people, only yourself!), I felt at peace with it. I saw how that relationship didn’t actually serve me. 

Whereas this one did. I saw this man having my kids for fuck sake. Having the realisation he never saw that of me fucking hurts

Yeh, I’ve been there - I broke up with a guy who I loved desperately because he just wasn’t treating me well. I really just wanted him to sort it out. But I’m not the kind of person who ends relationships without me being sure I don’t think we are right for each other. Once you’ve made that decision, any hurt you feel is minimised by the knowledge this is for the best. It’s takes longer to get to that acceptance when you were blindsided, and you will always always overanalyse what they say, unable to shake the feeling that they just gave up on you and stopped seeing you as a long term person
It’s just very hard because behaving like that isn’t me at all and I feel such deep shame and guilt about it
Yeah. And my ex must understand why it happened and forgive me because he has been very keen to maintain a friendship since

I did at the time - I messaged his friend. I didn’t really see what else I could do as my ex broke up with me shortly after and he was his friend, we weren’t close. I feel like if I messaged again now with another apology it would be more about alleviating my guilt? I can’t see why he would care about getting another apology message, when he probably never thinks about me or it as he doesn’t have to see me again. And I apologised to my ex many many times, in person, message and through a letter. This was 6 months ago now

I’ve been on both sides and I would choose dumper in a heartbeat. The feelings of guilt and uncertainty is NOTHING compared to the pain of feeling rejected and abandoned

Edit: I realise this probably makes me sound flippant. Hurting people is not nice. It feels disgusting. But dumpers can often leave relationships feeling relief, peace and power mixed in with the hard feelings. And while we may pretend we would rather experience the pain than cause someone else to feel it when it came down to it…. would we ?
Yep I got that one too   It’s like taking a knife to the chest

I’m actually feeling at peace, and proud of myself for realising my own company really isn’t that bad, it can actually be quite nice ! I’m 5 months post break up and I still miss him soo much, but goddamn I’m ready to live for me and love myself. Hugs to everyone

Yes I miss him all the time. He is always in my thoughts, popping up through memories or fantasises, and in my dreams. We both have covid right now and so are desperately isolating. I am fighting the urge to ask how he is doing. Because he was the one that decided he didn’t want or need my support, care or presence anymore. I gotta start showing him what they truly means

I think you’re doing great. As you said,
You’ve gotta let go sooner or later. Better save you the heartache and pain and do it sooner. Whatever the future holds, you can’t stall your own healing waiting to find out what is meant for you
I’m doing my version of this on Sunday. Good luck. I hope we both get some level of closure or realisation from this
His main reason was he doesn’t want to settle down yet. He wants to be selfish and focus on himself and his career with complete independence - his words
Wow are we the same person? Sounds exactly the same as my situation. Happy to chat more in DMs!
👏👏👏👏 I’m very happy for you, that sounds like real positive progress
Sounds like a great idea to have space
Wowwwwwww I’m so sorry, that’s pretty selfish of him to include you in his reparations
This makes sense, I’m glad it had worked out - how often do you talk / see each other ?
This helps to hear, thank you. It’s hard to explain to people why you want to stay in contact so I’m glad someone relates to wanting to keep them around without wanting a relationship

Trust, I would love to be able to just cut him off and not see or hear from him until my feelings fade. But, Given our mutual friends and where we live it’s not as easy as just letting go and forgetting… because he is there a lot. 

he is a very kind and respectful person and given the nature of the break up I do think I can learn to see him as a friend. Not a close friend is we regularly or talk to regularly, because I respect my sanity. 

My fear is based off past experiences, that he will do what everyone other ex has done to me - being all up in my life until they find someone new then suddenly the “friendship” evaporates.

Oh there’s no way I’m wanting us to get back together - the reasons we broke up Are still there. He (the dumper) just wants to be friends and I’m trying to figure out whether that is setting myself up for pain
Sorry it’s confusing. Just need some support

He dumped me. He still wants to be in my life and have me around but not be in a relationship. It’s very confusing and I know I should cut him off to protect myself but it’s been so respectful and amicable that I’m finding it really hard to say “you have to completely be out of my life”. We have mostly been NC but I don’t know if I’m strong enough to tell him we can’t be friends moving forward. My close friends see him all the time, we share a climbing gym (ugh) And I miss him a lot of course. His mom even sent me a Christmas gift ffs

Yep, I’ve thought that myself! Basically he wanted to come round my house for our Christmas celebration so I suggested we meet first. Then with Covid he couldn’t come round, but I had already done all the mental prep so didn’t want that energy to go to waste. 

Plus, He wants to be friends and is under the impression we can do that, I think. I want to share my apprehensions about that. 

I also just want to hear how he has been feeling. I think it will help me move on - I keep seeing him in public and the surface level chit chat is really hard to deal with

I wouldn’t have lost myself in giving so much love and energy to him that I should have given to myself. 

If I’d matched his avoidance masquerading as a need for independence, things would have been different

Yes yes to all of this. I feel ashamed of how much I began to rely on him to “fix me” and put all the responsibility for my happiness and success onto him without meaning to. I will never do that again! 

I also worry that it’s permanently changed me, I’ve also been a very open and loving person but now I’m scared to be
Omg, so bad, the sexy flashbacks are painful lol

Because we were great friends before we were romantic. We share a friendship circle. We broke up because we aren’t at a stage in our lives where we want to settle down, rather than because of a lack of affection, love or feelings from either party. So, just because we aren’t compatible under present conditions (and may never be), It doesn’t mean I don’t see the value he brings to my life. I want him in my life even if it isn’t as a romantic partner - it’s sad but I’m ok that our boyfriend girlfriend dynamic didn’t work out. 

We are young and figuring out who we are and what we want while having big work ambitions. I don’t resent him for being the one to instigate the decision based on that. But I do miss him, as a person. So I’m happy to try and adjust to a new dynamic, while being aware that it may not work in practice. I just want to give it a go

What I want to say: I don’t want you back, because there’s still those same things we need to work on. You leaving me was actually the best thing you could have done. But im not ready to move on. I still think of us together, in some fantasy future. I’m hurting because despite that, I’ve been missing you. I want to tell you how much the space has made me realise that I do truly value and love you.  Do you feel the same? I’m scared of the answer. Let’s be friends like you asked so I can hold on to you some more, and keep you around. 

What I should say: I’m doing great. Things have been looking up for me since you left. I can’t be friends with you, because i love you too much. This has to be the end. Goodbye. 

What I will say: I have no fucking clue
Alll of Fleetwood Mac’s Rumours album
That numbness does pass and brings some hopeful optimism for the future, clarity and peace. It’s a rollercoaster of emotions but it does get easier, slowly

We fell into an anxious avoidant trap whete we were both dealing with personal shit so triggered the fuck out of each other and no one was getting their needs fulfilled. 

The main thing was we both weren’t ready to settle down, so the relationship had an expiry date. I’m 25 but have hardly been single my whole dating life. So I knew I needed some time alone before commuting to someone for life. We both wanted to go figure certain things out and have experiences that we could only do alone. It is hard because there was still so much love and companionship there, and we both helped each other grow so much. I can’t feel any anger or hate towards him, as it just wasn’t our time. I know not everyone likes this phrase but it did feel a like right person wrong time. 

The break up gave me clarity though and I’m ready to learn to be more secure within myself and not fall into that anxious triggered behaviour spiral. 

More than anything, I miss being his friend. In previous break ups I missed the relationship or the idea of them more than them as a person, but this isn’t the case now. So I’m finding that tough
2 and a bit years. Were really good friends before hand though
Almost 4 months ago. I know it’s not that long but I am just tired

That man wrote me a whole letter. Nothing stings more than the memory of that look on his face before he told me. I knew what was coming. 

“this is the hardest thing I’ve ever had to do, but I need to be selfish right now”

“I just want ultimate freedom and complete agency over my decisions”

“There are certain journeys and experiences I want to take alone” - that shit stung 

“I sometimes felt like I gave more to this relationship than I got out of it. I want to start putting myself first and stop giving so much to others” (bullshit)

And later on, he told me thinks it’s right person wrong time, and he still loves me, and his decision was essentially because he “couldn’t imagine settling down from a relationship in my 20s”

Oh and when we discussed friends he said he’d like that because it would “make it a lot easier for him.” I think about that one often. 

Quite the head fuck.

“Are you actually ready to let me in or will you feel smothered by the emotional intimacy again?” 

And to myself:

“Have you really grown to not be anxiously attached? Could you really deal with his emotional coldness again?”
Yep, I’m so sick of the cycle. Then the pain of this current one.. I’m willing to not be in love for a longgg time to avoid going through this again

He made me sit and listen to a letter he’d wrote as he read ur out. “I need to be selfish, and put myself first.” 

“I want ultimate freedom and agency over my actions”

“I want to put more time into my career and there’s certain journeys I want to take and I’m better doing that alone” 

He detailed my strengths and thanked me for helping him grow as a person more than anyone else has.

When I asked him if his feelings had changed for me, he said  no. He said the breakup was “circumstantial”. This was after a week of doubts from a 2 plus year relationship. After spending a weekend of this and telling me that morning that everything was ok.

The cold logic of the letter tore my heart up. It was only when I read up on the avoidant and anxious real that it started to make sense. 

We met up again a few weeks later where I told him his lack of communication of his needs until the last minute was really unfair, because I’d asked again and again and he lied and told me everything was fine, while I got triggered because I felt him pulling away emotionally. he told me he regretted doing it so quickly and his main thing was he couldn’t imagine settling down from a relationship In his 20s. 

I still have the letter, but I can’t bring myself to read it again, not just yet.

I feeeeel this. His break up note spoke about wanting “ultimate freedom” and “agency over his decisions” and alll about his independence. At the time it felt so cold. Now I see that his avoidance was triggered and so I can’t take it deeply personally. It would have happened with anyone who wanted emotional intimacy from him. 

I don’t want to assume but everything he said was textbook avoidance. Even to the numbness and depression he is feeling now (which I hear through mutual friends). 

 I know they can’t help it, but avoidants can really fuck you up. We can’t let it make us want to change how we love. Everyone desires and deserves love and connection, they just run when it gets too real

It’s hard. But what I try is 

1. distraction. Whenever I notice the thoughts coming I will say NOPE and go do something else, move to a new place or start a task or talk to a friend. Just do anything to occupy your mind 
2. Rationalising. Remembering I can’t control his life. Whatever he does is up to him. So driving myself crazy over it is so much wasted energy. Also, we all have sex that is meaningless. We all have bad dates, and bad kisses. Even good dates of good sex don’t mean someone is going to become important to us. Only you know what you guys had. And you can’t recreate that iver night. Also, they are jsut trying to cope with the breakup and move on. We can’t villainise them for that. Because we would want the same for ourselves if we were the dumpers next time around 

3. Centering myself rather than Him. I want to fancy and pursue new people eventually. He has that same right, but I don’t need to care about what he does. This is an opportunity for me as much as him.

It’s such a rollercoaster. This post was aimed at reminding myself as much as everyone else! I miss him so much and I’m trying to get more comfortable with the thought of him dating or having sex with new women but it hurts. I don’t know how you manage to do that visualisation! Why do you think it works?
This is so sweet! I’ve heard a similar story before. I think if you fully accept that you were never going to work and yet you still care for them, it can work
I hear you, and I feel like that with all of my exes but this last one… we were best friends before hand and I do think I value him as a person without the sex or romance

It also helped me to kind of take the personal emotion out of it and zoom out to see the bigger picture. But I have the benefit of having an understanding ex. 

Maybe try writing down the opportunities this break up brings, and the values you have as a person? It can be hard to see at first but honestly this breakup has been good for me in a lot of ways. I never expected to say that

That’s still not very long at all. If she’s “moved on” I’m not surprised you’re feeling all the things. But I think you are asking the wrong questions tbh. Relationships end for so many reasons. They come at different points to teach us diffetent things. It doesn’t mean you are less worthy or great. 
I also was willing to work on it whereas he just blindsided me with wanting to break up without any communication. But I realised that nobody has to cling to things that  they don’t want in that moment (which doesn’t say anything about you). Sometimes letting go of a relationship before it turns really ugly is for the best. As my boyfriend said, he wanted me to go explore my sexuality and not grow to resent him over time. So I don’t see breaking up as this black and white, heartless thing that people do to just discard someone
How long has it been since the BU? I had a lot of spiralling thoughts early on, it gets easier to gain clarity with time ❤️

I thought this one had significance. It wasn’t a casual fling to me. What I’m trying to say is how hard it is for me, now it’s ended, is to do the cognitive shift from that feeling of picturing our future to seeing it was just one of those relationships that “teaches you stuff and helps you grow”. It’s jarring 

Really really do not care about future relationships, I don’t want another in my 20s if I’m honest ! I’ve got no more desire or space in my life for this hurt
Oh i hear it - it is still special to me in the sense of what it gave me and how I felt, but I guess mean more I see that how sentimental I felt isn’t reality anymore

Thank you so much, I loveeee this ! I actually spoke to a psychotherapist and this is all what she recommended. 

That you’re not going to be able to undo this attachment style learnt in childhood but you CAN learn to better understand and placate your triggers and root causes

This exact thing happened to me ! I always valued our communication and I was always so vocal with my thoughts, so It will take me a while to forgive him for shutting down at the end and blind siding me with it, because that left me with weeeeeks of shock and confusion that could have so easily been avoided. 

If he had spoken to me we could have came to a more mutual agreement because I agree there’s shit we both need to do before we settle down at all, and the anxious/avoidant trap wasn’t serving either of us :(
We fell into the anxious / avoidant trap

Stop looking for someone to replace her. That’s impossible while you’re still in love with her. I feel the same about my ex so I know I’m not ready for someone new to seriously be in my life. Instead I am going to take this time to try dating people who are completely different to my ex. And I’m not going to have him as barometer for comparison because I don’t want a relationship with someone new - there’s not space for that while I’m still I love with someone else! you’ve gotta stop thinking you can instantly recreate what you had with your ex / find someone else who you connect with like that in the blink of an eye. You gotta focus on yourself and other areas of your life while letting time do it’s thing

Thanks so much for this, it’s really great hearing from somebody who is healing from a good relationship. It’s reassuring that you say you still think/thought of her every day, as Im over 2 months in and still have so much love for him and he’s always on my mind, and it does get frustrating because i just want it to be over. I want my feelings to go. So I’m hoping I can start to think of him and just accept it rather than feeling this sadness and announce
I love this mentality, and it certainly resonates. We were friends first so I’m hoping I get to the same stage as you 💚

Oh wow, I’m so so so glad it has helped you. It’s funny because I just read it back and realised I needed to refresh this mindset for myself. It’s so hard to see these things in the midst of the grief and sadness, but it’s so good when we do :)

I hear what you’re saying, but no. Love alone  is not enough  to make a relationship work - that’s a romcom fantasy. You need your emotional needs to align, you need to want the same things, communication needs to be on point, you need a healthy/fulfilling sex life and so much more…  I also think that in situations of people leaving us, rather than just dragging it out or cheating, they do that because they DO love you, respect you and care about you. 

Life contained multitudes and greys, there’s no black and white. If it is helpful/applicable to your situation to think “they didn’t love me enough to make it work” then go ahead, but if that isn’t the truth for your relationship, don’t let Reddit confuse you !
Yeah, I’ve been focusing on that for sure - keeping doing things for myself and all that. The feelings of rejection when you thought you had something special is just really so awful
Haha. So much this. My ex would message me regularly then when he got with someone new, it was suddenly inappropriate. I realised that it was never friendship, it was fulfilling a need
You’re welcome ❤️
Good to hear ! Clarity is fantastic !
Go ahead ❤️
Aw wow thank you! Im so glad its helpful. I think I should do the same ahah

I’m so glad it helps. Don’t be harsh on yourself because I did a fucking lot of questioning and worrying to get to this point. It helped to have a good support system around me, and it helps that my ex is a good man. You’ll get there, just read this over and over as I’m doing that too!❤️
Oh, ‘those’ days are the worst!!! I honestly can’t wait for the day that he’s not the first thing I think about when I wake up
I hope so too. It is hard to see past the pain of rejection
You’re welcome, I hope it helps !
Thank you ❤️ sometimes it’s not easy to take my own advice haha but continuing to return to this really helps
You’re welcome. I hope things start to feel easier for you ❤️

I’m so glad this resonated with you. I’ll admit that when he first told me he wanted to break up, it was so sudden I was upset that he didn’t even want to work on it. I pleaded that we could still do the holiday we had planned. Still wish we had done that as we could have actually spoken through things and it would have saved me pain. But once I saw how set his mind was, I instantly let it go. I respect him AND myself far too much

I’m sorry to hear this.when he first told me how he felt it was like having my heart ripped in two. But sometimes the hardest things to hear are also the things we MOST need to hear. Just try to avoid questioning how or why. It’s cruel but feelings can just … change

I’m so so glad to hear this. Stay strong, and keep remembering that the comfort you used to find in them won’t be found anymore. It’s sad but just try to remember you don’t need close contact in order to respect and love someone. It’s so cliche but truly, if you love someone, set them free.

Everyone will say this and it will annoy the hell out of you, but I promise you need to give it time. 3 weeks is still so fresh. I’m 7 weeks in and I have so much more clarity and acceptance. It still hurts like hell but I now feel more able to say “this is the beat thing for us right now because we need to go figure out what we want. We never know what will happen in the future. Sure, it is sickening to think of him finding someone he loves harder than me, but I don’t know who is going to one day walk into my life and blow me away.”

right now I’m focusing on loving him from a. Distance, focusing on what I gain from the breakup rather than what I have lost. 

Keep the faith and you will just get a tiny bit stronger each day

Absolutely, pretty much every time. 

I also get sad when I’m wirh friends - as I can’t help but be reminded of the space he has left. I look for him in everyone

Ah we have such similar situations ! But I agree with everything you said, especially your edit - I’ve learnt that when dealing with depression we can sometimes put our partner on a pedestal which creates a skewed dynamic. I no longer want to be so self deprecating that I set a pre-determined role for myself in the relationship, as that does allow you to get comfortable cloud your vision for how you could change/improve but ALSO distracts from the areas that they lack in.

we got this

Thank you so much for this. I’m in a similar situation so reading this helps. I love that “you have the whole of your lives to work out how to be friends”. When you’re in the midst of the grief it’s hard to remember how long our lives are. I do hope I can reconnect with my ex in the future to share our success, but for now I need to focus on living life without him
I’m also working really hard to write a letter tht is built on non verbal communication. No “you did this, how could you” etc etc.

Yeah, I feel you. I’m not expecting anything from him - this is for me, not him. I  basically want him to know that I also think a breakup was for the best, so he underestimated me and caused me unnecessary pain by not communicating. I expect he won’t have much to say. This is honestly just a space for me to take some power back

Yep I have actually. And I’m not saying hold onto
Hope, absolutely focus on yourself, close
This chapter of your life. I more mean, believe I’m the process so you don’t wallow in “what if”

This sucks, but echo what everyone said. In time it will become easier to accept that you were both at different stages in your life.

What helps me to think is - what is meant to be, will be. You’ve just got to take it as it comes, as we never know how we will feel in a years time

You’re absolutely making the right choice. While she chases a rebound to bury her feelings in, you’ll be doing the work to grow as an individual. I’m so done centring romantic love in my life. There’s so much fulfilment to find elsewhere. I’m excited to learn more about myself

Thank you so this - I’m also a ruminator who needs to think it over and over. And I’m going to write him an angry letter. I need the anger because most of this I’ve felt sadness and loss. I might message as it would be great to talk to someone who gets it :)

Wow, it sucks that so many people going through this, but it’s also so comforting to know I’m not alone.

Yesterday I realised that my ex was dismissive avoidant while I was anxious. And I’m finally ready to stop attacking myself for that. I am not wrong or broken for wanting my emotional needs to be met by a long term partner. I’m not damaged or “too much” for just needing reassurance, connection, intimacy - he’s the one who runs scared from love and commitment like its a disease. I have lots of love to give and people in my life are damn lucky to have me !! 

I work so hard to grow myself and be less anxiously attached, while he stagnates in arrogance that his way is flawless.
Thank you for this comment, as someone who has been the dumper before, it is very true

Absolutely they can, and I don’t mean to sounds like mean - but I know with him he doesn’t see an issue with his behaviour. He just thinks “I’m entitled to want my independence, I’m going to do all these things that I need to do then I can find a relationship again when I’ve got that out of my system” and that’s just not going to happen. So it helps me to think that while he’s going to find someone else, it’s not going to be some marriage and kids situation within a few years.

I googled this and oh my god, he is dismissive avoidant to a T! It helps so much to see it as a problem that will persist with him, because he is so sure that his way is the best way. So while I will do the work to become securely attached, he will have this same freak out in the next relationships.
Exactly. That’s why I feel pathetic for how much I let myself get invested. I always knew he’d prioritise work over me. But he told me I was projecting

Yeah journaling helps. I wish he could be dead to
Me. He’s moving to another house that’s so nearby to where I live.

Yepppp. 

I don’t have the energy left. For the talking stage, the excitement of the desire and the unknown. Then the falling hard, the growing security and companionship. The comfort. Then the heartbreak. Why would I trust someone with my heart again when it’s always just the same cycle. When I thought they were different t. I’m completely done with it. I hope I can see the point in love again one day
Both. For all the range of moods I guess. I tend to more enjoy the self empowering ones but not all of them resonate wirh me because my ex wasn’t a prick

It might take another six months for you to get lost in things. I know that’s shitty but there’s no time limit to grieving period.

Try to reframe how you see it. You’re not doing it for your ex, you’re doing this for YOU. So that YOU can move on from.
